name: Step caption pill for a wordless demo

source.description: 2 inspected reference films (batch-3, batch-5, 2026-11-26): a wordless light product demo names each step in a one-line dark pill at bottom centre.

technique: In a product demo without a voice, a dark rounded pill at bottom centre carries one short line naming the current step and changes only when the step changes. It narrates without competing with the interface.
purpose: Narrate a wordless demo one step at a time without competing with the interface.
visual_behaviour: A near-black rounded pill at bottom centre carries one short white line naming the current step; it changes only when the next step starts.
mechanics: Pill: near-black fill, full corner radius, 12-16 px white sentence-case text, one line of 4-8 words, about 90% down the frame, centred. It enters with a 0.2-0.3 s fade and a 4-6 px rise, holds 3.5-5 s, and swaps on the step's first action (ref-ad023ce9dc cues at about 4.9, 11.6, 15.4, 20.6 and 25.9 s). No word highlight.

decomposition.timing: One cue per step; 3.5-5 s each; 5 cues in 30 s in the reference.

parameters.name: lane
parameters.description: Vertical position as a fraction of frame height

use_cases: Step labels when there is no narration
Portrait reels with a free lower third
failure_modes: A caption that repeats the UI text adds nothing
Cues that change faster than about 2.5 s cannot be read alongside the UI

implementation.approach: Studio.comp.captions with a pill look (or the caption-plate composition): one line of 4-8 words, about 90% down the frame, fade plus 4-6 px rise in 0.2-0.3 s, held 3.5-5 s and swapped on the step's first action. No word highlight; cue times come from the storyboard steps, not from speech. Kept separate from caption-voice-strip (a typed script that is the film's voice): this is a held label per step.

requirements: caption plate in the lower lane

provenance.observed: Five one-line step captions in a dark pill at bottom centre, each held 3.5-5 s, over a music-only demo.

A vertical move title (two to four characters and a small romanised line) at the top right swaps in place with each move, about every 1.5 s (1.86, 4.83, 9.29 s). Note: Corner variant without a pill (check score 0.22 for 'named move title'): the same job, naming the current step and changing only with the step; it becomes a giant ghost in the sun for the finale.

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from user-supplied references (inspiration-only, rights unknown).
